bagPolicy.summary: The Kia Center enforces a strict no bag policy to ensure guest safety. Exceptions are made for small clutch bags and medically necessary items.
allowed: Small clutch bags no larger than 6.5" x 4.5"
Medical and parent bags (max. 14" x 14" x 6")
bagPolicy.note: Medical and parent bags are exceptions but will be subject to X-ray.

parking.note: Parking is available at the ThreatLocker Garage and 520 W Pine St. Garage, with prices ranging from $10-$20. Reserved parking can be purchased via Ticketmaster or the Kia Center Box Office. Accessible parking is available with direct elevator access.

rideshare.note: Guests are encouraged to be dropped off and picked up at the corner of Hughey and Pine Street.

concessions.note: Kia Center has expanded its food and beverage offerings to include eight local favorites, featuring a new 4(or)7 menu with items priced at $4 or $7. Highlights include Nauti Lobstah, Black Rooster Taqueria, Domi Italian Ice, and Kelly’s Homemade Ice Cream.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Kia Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Kia Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: You may also purchase tickets in-person by visiting the Kia Center box office on Church Street.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: In general, doors open to the public (1) hour before the printed event time on your ticket.
